landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: The request carries count_damage_after_fight_end (default true). On, a hit a cast lights inside the fight still lands after it: the reading burns and DoT tails always had, now uniform over delayed single hits too. Off, FightState.clip_to_window drops every landing past the fight end in the cast plan, the cast pricing loop, the stacking-DoT integral, the ability tick events and the burn tail. The default reverses the clipping #323 introduced for single-instant hits, so every leaf that receipt moved down moves back to its pre-#323 value.
why: River chose option 3 on 2026-09-10 after the contradiction was raised: #323 clipped a fused bomb in a 1 s fight while a burn lit at 0.5 s kept its full tail (a reading measured in game: Cassiopeia + Blackfire over 3 s, in-game about 90 against a capped 30). One switch keeps both readings honest and the result says which one it used.
Every pair diff is the exact reverse of expected-golden-diff-323-fight-window-landing.json: sustained-scenario totals and proc rows rise back to their counted values.

Every coupled diff is the reverse of that receipt's: the late events the walk refuses as outside_window are authored again, the dropped cast returns with its resource cost (resource_remaining and closing_current fall back by it), sequences renumber, per-attacker totals and the vamp healing rise back.

qualifying_population.rule: The population is the set of leaves expected-golden-diff-323-fight-window-landing.json declared, moving back; no path outside that receipt's jurisdiction moves.

/metadata/fingerprint/leaves.cause: the late events, the returned cast and their healing rows come back

summary.direction: every damage leaf moves up; the two downward leaves are the returned cast's mana
